label: Fashion / retail storefront

imagery_roles.hero: fashion boutique storefront clothing rack wide

prompt_hints: Product-first merchandising — sharp corners, high-contrast type, short punchy copy.
Showcase drops and bestsellers; keep the mid-page stack tight; avoid long process essays.
Copy as the store ("Shop the drop", "Add to bag") — never agency pitch language.

hero.headline: New drop. Clean lines. Ready to wear tonight.
hero.subcopy: Seasonal essentials and limited runs — sized honestly, shipped fast, returned easily.
